tools.name: search_golf_prices
tools.description: Search GolfPrice AI’s live UK golf price tracking by model, brand or category (e.g. "Pro V1", "TaylorMade driver", "rangefinder under 200"). Returns each matching model’s lowest new, in-stock UK price today, how many UK retailers stock it, our buy/wait verdict and a link to its price page with full

tools.name: get_golf_price
tools.description: Full GolfPrice AI price facts for one model: lowest new UK price today and where, every UK retailer we track that stocks it, the lowest/highest/average price we have recorded and for how many days, and our verdict on whether now is a good time to buy. Use a model_id from search_golf_prices.

tools.name: golf_price_drops
tools.description: Genuine price drops in the last 7 days on golf models GolfPrice AI tracks: the lowest new UK price fell by at least £5 and 3% and is still at the lower price. Measured against GolfPrice AI’s own price history, never a retailer’s "was" price.
